shortDescription: Google-parent Alphabet NASDAQ:GOOG kicked off a euro-denominated bond sale on Monday that is expected to be priced later in the day, the IFR news service reported.Alphabet will sell bonds over seven tranches, IFR reported, with the bond maturities ranging from two to 19 years.
